metadata.description: Old Roman gradual of the Lateran basilica, Rome, 12th century: the Roman chant dialect, not the Gregorian melody. Central Italian neumes (nota romana) on a red F line with letter clefs. The gradual Diffusa est, f. 33v.
metadata.title: Graduale (Old Roman)
metadata.transcription: Read note by note from the Vatican Library's photograph of f. 33v by two independent readers, October 2026; the syllables they read differently settled from the page by a third, who removed the show-through of f. 33r; see research/diffusa-est/staff-readings/README.md.
